customManagers.description: Renovate leaves the paired sha256 alone, so a bump fails its checksum until someone refreshes it

Without a version, mise-action and the mise feature each install the newest mise on their own schedule, so one dependency keeps every pin in a single pull request. Each mise-action step lists version first under with

packageRules.description: prek-action's prek-version and mise.toml pin the same prek, so one pull request bumps both
Provider and Terraform updates change every later plan, bootstrap's included

Merging a change to any of terraform-apply.yml's paths applies it. One matching file holds the whole pull request, because Renovate automerges a branch only when every upgrade in it qualifies. Keep in step with terraform-apply.yml's paths
